title.en: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred

text.en:
Items (a) and (b), paragraph 34, for the Province of Nueva Vizcaya, page 946, Title G, Section three of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(a) Various Communal Irrigation Sys­ tems, Solano Improvement and construction inc luding the purchase of cement for the construction and/or repair of dams ₱20,000.00 "(b) Busilac Communal Irrigation System, Bayombong 5,000.00 "(b-1) Various Communal Irrigation Sys tems, Bayombong Improvement and construction including the purchase of cement for the construction and/or repair of dams 20,000.00 "(b-2) Magat-La Torre-Wakal-U d d i a-wan-Bintawan Irrigation Systems, Bayombong Improvement and construction including the purchase of cement for the construction and/or repair of dams 25,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 18, 1961.
